boundary: run(input: Js.Unsafe.top Js.t) -> Typed_array.uint8Array Js.t: reads the input JSON in place via Js.typeof and Js.Unsafe.get; text stays Js.js_string Js.t (UTF-8 via TextEncoder/TextDecoder, Latin-1 via charCodeAt/String.fromCharCode); internal buffers and outputs are JS Typed_array uint8Array/uint16Array/int32Array returned directly with zero copy.
